description: The first (or a full) deployment of a project into the person's cloud, once a hosting plan is selected. Without confirm=true it changes nothing and returns the plan and its monthly cost. With confirm=true it creates resources the person's cloud provider bills them for; it takes 5 to 20 minutes. Needs Operate access.

confirm.description: true deploys; without it nothing is created

confirm_cost.description: true allows a plan above the account's cost ceiling

project.description: The project's id, name or repository (owner/name).

workspace.description: A teammate's workspace id. Default: your own.

name: launch
title: Launch a project
